A number of ways in which we use energy are listed.
In which is the ultimate source of energy not the Sun?
A
Energy is provided by a horse to pull a cart.
B
Energy is provided by hydroelectric generators to heat a house.
C
Energy is provided by a nuclear power station.
D
Energy is provided by a windmill to pump water to a fountain.
